generatedNote: Inventory of the Blora Design 1.x CSS public surface, extracted from blora.css. Covers --blora-* custom properties, .blora-* classes, data-blora-* attributes, structure, and notable patterns.

organization.layerNote: No @layer declarations are used. The stylesheet relies entirely on source order, selector specificity, and :where() (zero-specificity) wrappers to keep the reset/base rules from inflating specificity.
organization.scopeMechanism: Three root scopes gate base styles: body.blora-page, .blora-scope, .blora-portal. Component styles use the .blora-* class prefix. Palette/dark/size modes switch via :root[data-blora-*] and :root.blora-dark attribute/class selectors.

customProperties._note: Grouped by token category. Each entry: name, value, selector, line. Value shown is the default :root (Coral light) definition unless noted. Palette + dark overrides summarized separately after categories.

typography.name: --blora-font-heading
typography.value: Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

typography.name: --blora-font-sans
typography.value: Avenir, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

shadow.name: --blora-shadow-primary
shadow.value: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--blora-primary) 18%, transparent), 0 2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--blora-primary) 15%, transparent)

component_specific.name: --blora-float-shift-x
component_specific.note: Set by JS for tooltip/popover/dropdown horizontal shift

paletteOverrides._note: Light-mode palette presets redefine only color + a few derived tokens at :root[data-blora-palette="<name>"]. Non-color tokens (spacing/radius/shadow/motion/typography) are inherited unchanged.

darkModeOverrides._note: Dark mode (:root.blora-dark) redefines surface/text/shadow tokens globally, and each palette has its own dark variant. Dark functional colors (primary/danger/etc.) are NOT overridden for all palettes - only indigo, lotus, ocean, graphite, mono, circuit, coral, dusk get explicit dark functional colors. cinnabar dark only overrides surface/text/code tokens.

densityOverrides._note: Global density via html[data-blora-size="sm"|"lg"] overrides control metrics + text-sm.

dataAttributes._note: All data-blora-* attributes consumed by CSS selectors.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.purpose: Per-instance navbar variant (class/data attr kept for backward compat)

attributes.name: data-blora-error-ui
attributes.appliedTo: form field containers (used by JS to toggle .blora-error--popup)
attributes.note: Referenced in comment; CSS itself keys off .blora-error--popup class

attributes.name: data-blora-when
attributes.purpose: Conditional field visibility (JS-driven); CSS hides via .is-when-hidden or [hidden]

attributes.name: data-blora-sort
attributes.purpose: Enable sortable column header with aria-sort indicators

attributes.name: data-blora-text-fx
attributes.purpose: Text animation effect selector (alternative to .blora-text-fx--* class)
attributes.note: Referenced in comment; effect classes are .blora-text-fx--<name>

attributes.name: data-layout
attributes.note: Not data-blora-* prefixed but used in selectors

attributes.name: data-prefix
attributes.purpose: Line number/prefix label in code mockups

classes._note: All .blora-* public classes grouped by component. Each component lists base, modifiers, states, sub-elements.

scope_and_page.note: Root scoping classes that gate base/reset/typography rules

usages.context: navbar menu hidden on mobile (display: none !important)
navbar secondary hidden on mobile (display: none !important)

important.note: !important is mostly used to defeat native browser chrome (search-cancel, calendar-picker) and to force-zero native input styling inside the custom select trigger, plus the reduced-motion guard and the .blora-hide utility.

transitionAll.note: transition: all is used on interactive elements (buttons, selects, checkbox/radio/switch tracks). A refactor should prefer explicit property lists.

hardcodedColorsInComponentCSS.note: hardcoded black/white gradients for color picker spectrum
hardcoded rainbow gradient for hue slider

otherPatterns.backdropFilterUsage: navbar, dropdown menus, popovers, color panels, datepicker/timepicker panels, dock, megamenu, modal mask, image preview

scopeSelectors.note: Base/reset/typography rules are scoped via :where(body.blora-page, .blora-scope, .blora-portal). Component classes work in any of these scopes.
